about_the_game:
February 2022.
Your country is under invasion by a powerful neighbor. Outnumbered and outgunned, only one unit stands between survival and total defeat: the Shadow Division.

Take command of a covert intelligence agency fighting a silent war beneath the surface. Recruit elite agents, plan high-risk operations, and shape the global response. Assassinate enemy operatives, sabotage critical infrastructure, hack into enemy systems, and uncover foreign plots.

In Shadow Division: Spymaster, strategy is everything.
Will you weaken the enemy from within? Bolster your own military with precision strikes and intelligence? Or manipulate international politics to gain critical foreign support?

Every choice matters.
Watch for double agents. Counter rival spies. Influence world opinion.
The fate of your nation lies in the shadows.

🧠 Key Features:

  • 🕵️‍♂️ Manage up to 60 agents across the globe: each with unique traits and specializations

  • 🎯 Conduct over 200 operations: from sabotage and assassination to propaganda, cyber strikes, and blackmail

  • 🛰️ Gather intelligence on enemy forces, political movements, and foreign governments

  • 🌐 Manipulate global opinion: influence alliances, incite protests, or force embargoes

  • 🔐 Hunt down enemy spies and protect your agency from infiltration

  • 💻 Hack systems, intercept communications, and disable enemy infrastructure

  • 🧩 Dynamic strategy gameplay: no two playthroughs are the same

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains stylized depictions of covert operations including assassination, sabotage, and political manipulation.

All violence is presented through text-based descriptions or strategic icons, with no graphic imagery.
Themes of espionage, war, and international conflict are present throughout.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 530 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: A modern-day strategy game where you lead a covert intelligence agency, run sabotage and assassination missions, manipulate international politics, and adapt your strategy in a highly replayable campaign.
